body.prompt: Night in a plain stone room of a Roman imperial residence. Close view of a round polished bronze hand mirror standing on a wooden table, lit by a single small clay oil lamp beside it. In the warm, slightly distorted bronze reflection we see the soft blurred face of a tired older bearded man looking at himself, face only visible inside the mirror and slightly out of focus; outside the mirror only his shoulder in dark wool is visible at the edge of the frame, from behind. A folded white toga with purple stripe lies on a stool in the shadows. Quiet, introspective, intimate. Cinematic oil-painting look, like a dark Renaissance chiaroscuro painting brought to life, deep warm shadows, muted bronze, umber and deep navy palette, fine film grain, painterly texture, vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the lower half, a calm dark area in the top third for text. Absolutely no text, no letters, no inscriptions, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, nothing modern anywhere.
